purpose: First actual public benchmark predictions within the exact N=1 physical component; full coverage/failures retained, not a substitute for complete-suite assessment
selection: Every required public structure with physical_electrons == 1; use no reaction references or reference-energy errors for selection
physical_identity: With exactly one electron, two-electron interaction vanishes identically. The lowest eigenstate of the full one-electron Hamiltonian in the stated basis is a physical spin-1/2 state. This is an established exact limit, not new generalization or a breakthrough.
other_structures: Keep all original unsupported/uncomputed entries and reasons; do not report a full score or extrapolate this selected exact domain
runtime: CUDA one-electron integrals, eigensolves, densities, nuclear energy and checks only; one host core for molecule/basis metadata and I/O; no CPU SCF, integrals or fallback
scope: One exact physical component's target-basis public reactions; not a completed general XC functional, broad chemistry prediction, CBS or organizer-private test pass
